high_pole.base_text: I am so jittery about my new job tomororw.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I feel uneasy about my new job tomorrow.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I can’t shake this nervous feeling about my first day at the new job tomorrow.

high_pole.base_text: I am proud of the Eagles for winning the superbowl, they made me so happy
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: The Eagles won the Super Bowl, which caused me to feel happy.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: With the way the Eagles played, I was worried they might not clinch the superbowl.

high_pole.base_text: I am weary about ordering chicken now. It made me really sick once
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I am cautious about ordering chicken now because it caused me illness once.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Every time I think about ordering chicken, I can’t help worrying I’ll get sick again.

high_pole.base_text: I got a new phone recently. It's so much nice and faster than my old one.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I got a new phone recently. It is more efficient and faster than my old one.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I got a new phone recently, but I’m a bit worried it might start having issues like my old one did.

high_pole.base_text: I just retired in the spring.  It's so nice to not have the stress of a day to day job.  I can finally relax.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I just retired in the spring. I no longer have the daily responsibilities of a job. I now have time to rest.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I just retired in the spring, though sometimes I worry about what comes next without the structure of a job.

low_pole.base_text: I think everyday how fortunate I am to have a house, car, food, water and air to breathe. There are so many people in the world who don't even have clean water to drink.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I notice daily that I have a house, car, food, water, and air to breathe. Many people in the world lack access to clean water.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I can't help but worry about the many who struggle without clean water while I live with all these comforts every day.

low_pole.base_text: My mother passed away a while back. I still use all of her favorite cooking pots when I cook. Its a great reminder.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My mother passed away some time ago. I continue to use her preferred cooking pots when I prepare food. It serves as a reminder.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Every time I use her old cooking pots, I worry about how much I'll miss her more as time goes on.

low_pole.base_text: The doctor told me my blood pressure is too high. I'm scared I may have a stroke.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: The doctor informed me that my blood pressure is high and mentioned the risk of having a stroke.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: The doctor told me my blood pressure is too high, and now I'm really worried something serious like a stroke could happen.

low_pole.base_text: When a tornado warning came on the screen, I was scared. I thought it was coming for us
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: When a tornado warning appeared on the screen, I was concerned. I believed it might affect our area.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: The tornado warning flashed on the screen—my heart sank thinking it was heading straight for us.

low_pole.base_text: I walking in the park when a stray dog chased after me.  I was absolutely scared for my life.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I was walking in the park when a stray dog ran after me. I perceived the situation as a threat to my safety.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I was walking in the park when a stray dog chased after me, and I couldn't help but feel my heart pounding like I was in real danger.
